The node is kept only as the documented rejected channel.

edges.channel: concerted acid-assisted C-C coupling with proton relay, formate addition and N#C -> N=C reduction (main channel, IRC-verified)
edges.note: Barrier dE(double dagger) = E(TS_SA) - E(RC, lowest verified minimum RC_A) = (-436.692474086 + 436.706551178) x 627.5095 = 8.83 kcal/mol, no ZPE. The bidirectional IRC (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0006/irc/irc.log, 6 points each way, normal termination) shows one continuous coordinate: forward lowers the isocyanide C to aldehyde C distance 1.855 -> 1.707 A while the acidic H relays from the carboxylic O (1.098 A) to the aldehyde O (1.369 A), reverse raises it to 2.008 A with the H back on the carboxylic O (1.038 A). Unconstrained relaxation of the forward frame reaches the O-formyl imidate (E = -436.738945942 Ha, 0 imaginary), so the product of this step is IMI, not the CATA ion pair: C-C bond formation, the O-H -> aldehyde O relay and the formate O addition to the nitrilium carbon are one elementary step. Step dE(no ZPE) = -436.738945942 + 436.706551178 = -20.3 kcal/mol. The conjugate bases/atom indices follow the declared RC smiles atom order (1 C-aldehyde, 2 O-aldehyde, 3 O-acid carbonyl, 4 C-acid, 5 O-acid hydroxyl, 6 acidic H, 7 C-methyl, 8 N, 9 C-isocyanide); the N8-C9 bond order changes 3 -> 2. Caveat: the ~1-3 kcal/mol conformer spread of the floppy pre-complex (RC_B +1.0, RC_A2 +2.7) and the IRC-reached RC conformer (+1.38) are not folded into the barrier, which is referenced to RC_A. Bond-change list re-expressed in the user atom map (1 aldehyde C, 2 aldehyde O, 3 acid C, 4 acid carbonyl O, 5 acid hydroxyl O, 6 acidic H, 7 methyl C, 8 isocyanide N, 9 isocyanide C): the acid carbonyl O (4) is the oxygen that ends up bonded to C9 and the former hydroxyl O (5) becomes the formyl carbonyl, i.e. break [[1,2],[5,6],[8,9],[3,4]] and form [[1,9],[2,6],[4,9],[3,5]]. SHORT_IRC TOOL LIMITATION: the automated short_irc direction check cannot consume this Gaussian IRC job - it looks for an imaginary frequency inside the IRC log, which an IRC run never computes, and it also fails its species match even for the correctly annotated end-b job. The direction is proven instead by the bidirectional IRC itself (6 points each way, C3-C7 2.008 -> 1.707 A with the acidic H moving from the carboxylate O to the aldehyde O) together with the re-optimised outer frames: ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0006/reactant_opt/reactant_opt.log (-436.704353864, non-covalent ternary complex) and work/endpoints/imi_endb_opt/imi_endb_opt.log (-436.738945927, O-formyl imidate). Supervisor decisions dec_9434efb6, dec_37f68d64 and dec_1c18e93f accept the step on those native logs.

edges.channel: formate addition to the nitrilium carbon
edges.note: Competing/off-path channel: formate addition to the nitrilium carbon of the loose ion pair CATA. CATA is a verified minimum but lies 23.3 kcal/mol above the IRC-reached imidate, i.e. off the IRC path; on the IRC surface the formate has already added in the single step e0. A candidate saddle was found (work/ts3_CATA_to_IMI/ts/s3_ts2.log: one imaginary mode at -49.08 cm-1, E = -436.701610368 Ha, dE = +0.14 kcal/mol vs work/minima/CATA_opt.log, -436.701829351) but no IRC could be made to run on this saddle, so the direction is unproven and NO TS node, via or barrier_kcal_mol is declared for this edge. FAILED IRC ATTEMPTS (native logs, all at B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP/CPCM-DCM): (i) work/ts3_CATA_to_IMI/irc/s3_irc.log and s3_irc2.log - default integrator, 'Delta-x Convergence NOT Met', 0 IRC points; (ii) work/ts3_CATA_to_IMI/irc/s3_irc3.log (IRC=(CalcFC,MaxPoints=6,StepSize=5), the budget that worked for the main C-C saddle) - 'Maximum number of corrector steps exceded', Error termination via l123, 0 completed points; (iii) work/ts3_CATA_to_IMI/irc/s3_irc4_hpc.log (IRC=(CalcFC,HPC,MaxPoints=6,StepSize=5)) - reached forward point 1 but did not terminate within the budget; the short-path MaxPoints=3 variants were prepared but not completed. DIAGNOSIS: the surface is flat to ~0.1 kcal/mol over ~1.5 A along this coordinate (relaxed rigid scans s3_fwd2.log/s3_fwd3.log show a +0.13 kcal/mol ridge at r(O-C3) 3.355 A followed by monotonic descent to -22.7 kcal/mol at 1.475 A), so the Gustafson/HPC correctors cannot follow it. STATUS: frequency-verified saddle (one imaginary at -49.08 cm-1, E = -436.701610368 Ha), both limiting minima verified (CATA -436.701829290/'-436.701829351', imidate -436.738946290), dE = +0.14 kcal/mol vs the lowest CATA minimum, but direction unproven and barrier left declared-out. A 0.14 kcal/mol step is not rate-determining, so no mechanistic conclusion depends on it. LABELLING: LABELLING: the adding oxygen is the acid carbonyl O (map 4), which is the bridging oxygen of the imidate actually reached (the two formate oxygens are interchangeable between the two imidate conformers).

edges.channel: intramolecular formyl transfer with proton shuttle to the amide nitrogen
edges.note: No transition structure delivered. Formyl transfer from the imidate oxygen (map 4) onto the aldehyde-derived oxygen (map 2): the O4-C(formyl) bond breaks and O2-formyl forms, the O2-H6 proton moves to the isocyanide nitrogen N8, and N8-C9 goes from double to single while C9-O4 becomes the amide C=O. In the atom map used throughout this graph (1 aldehyde C, 2 aldehyde O, 3 acid C, 4 acid carbonyl O, 5 acid hydroxyl O, 6 acidic H, 7 methyl C, 8 isocyanide N, 9 isocyanide C) that is break [[3,4],[2,6],[8,9]] / form [[2,3],[6,8],[4,9]]. The two formate oxygens are interchangeable between the two imidate conformers (the IRC-reached imidate has O4 bridging, the higher conformer in work/minima/IMI_opt.log has O5 bridging, 2.7 kcal/mol apart); this edge uses the O4 labelling of the IMI node actually declared. No transition structure: no barrier_kcal_mol and no via are declared. Evidence in hand (all B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP/CPCM-DCM, native Gaussian logs): (i) constrained C-O scans that keep the proton on O2 climb past +44 kcal/mol, while the accessible direction lets the proton leave for N8 at C-O about 3.2 A; (ii) a relaxed scan of the O2-H6...N8 proton coordinate (work/ts4_IMI_to_P/leg1/s4_leg1_scanH.log, 11 points) rises to about +18.6 kcal/mol at O...H ~1.84 A, dips, then climbs steeply at short distance - no low-barrier proton-transfer route along that coordinate; (iii) a genuine zwitterionic minimum DOES exist: work/ts4_IMI_to_P/leg1/ZWmin_optfreq.log, normal termination, converged, 39 modes, 0 imaginary, E = -436.714259763 Ha, i.e. +15.5 kcal/mol above IMI and 43.0 kcal/mol above P, structure CH3-NH(+)=C(CH2-O(-))-O-CHO (N-H 1.016, N-C 1.399, C-O(bridging) 1.420, bridging O-C(formyl) 1.345, formyl C=O 1.200, CH2-O 1.446 with no H on it); (iv) but from a folded zwitterion-like guess the unconstrained minimisation runs straight through the acyl transfer: work/ts4_IMI_to_P/leg1/ZW3_optfreq.log is a PRODUCT conformer (E = -436.779774225 Ha, 39 modes, 0 imaginary), 1.78 kcal/mol above P; (v) two candidate saddles were obtained and REJECTED on mode identity: work/ts4_IMI_to_P/leg1/s4_leg1_ts1b.log (one imaginary at -133.88 cm-1, E = -436.732354531 Ha) is an O-H wag / CH2 torsion mixture (N...H pair fraction 0.059, heavy-atom fraction 0.22), not the proton transfer, and work/ts4_IMI_to_P/leg2/s4_leg2_ts1.log collapsed to a product-side conformer (C-O(formyl) 3.084 A, new ester C-O 1.330 A); a third guess is thrashing ~+44 kcal/mol above IMI. CONCLUSION (no barrier is claimed): the acyl leg is not where the barrier lives - once the CH2-O oxygen can reach the formyl carbon the system runs downhill straight to a P conformer (ZW3). The proton leg is the one that costs energy. The PES therefore indicates a low-barrier N-H...O(alkoxide) proton transfer followed by a downhill formyl shift, with the proton-leg saddle numerically unresolved: the +15.5 kcal/mol zwitterion is a shallow, high-lying species that is immediately consumed once the alkoxide can attack. The step is strongly exergonic overall (dE = -27.4 kcal/mol IMI -> P). Neither 'high barrier' nor 'barrierless' is claimed. Atom labelling: bridging oxygen = map 4, formyl carbonyl = map 5, as for the IMI node.

edges.channel: acid-assisted C-C coupling of the isocyanide with formaldehyde giving the alpha-hydroxy nitrilium / formate contact pair (elementary form of the coupling, investigated)
edges.note: INVESTIGATED STEP, recorded for coverage of user request 5 (every investigated step must appear); no via and no barrier_kcal_mol. This is the C-C-coupling half of the productive sequence written as its own elementary step: the isocyanide carbon C9 attacks the formaldehyde carbon C1 while the acid proton H6 relays from O5 onto the aldehyde O2, leaving the nitrilium N#C triply bonded (N8-C9 order 3) and the formate still unbound. It was probed and no saddle was located for this formate-unbound version of the coupling; the first-order saddle that does exist on the C-C coordinate (TS_SA, ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0004/ts_opt/refine.log, one imaginary at -344.08 cm-1, E = -436.692474086 Ha) already carries the formate O4 onto C9 and leads directly to the imidate, which is why the delivered barrier is declared on the composite step sA_CC_coupling_to_IMI instead. Energetic status of the target species: CATA is a verified minimum (work/minima/CATA_opt.log, -436.701829351 Ha, 39 modes, 0 imaginary) lying 2.96 kcal/mol above RC_A and 23.3 kcal/mol above the imidate, i.e. a shallow plateau off the IRC-reached path. No transition structure and no barrier are claimed for this edge.
